kind.description: Marks this file as a setup.

name.description: Display name. Default: the file name.

surfaces.description: Surfaces besides the Centre, such as one per player, made before the steps run. Default: only the Centre.

steps.description: Run in order on an empty table.

Setup.title: Trayful setup
Setup.description: A scripted starting layout that a table can be reset to.

id.description: Surface id, used in `surface:` targets and steps' `surface`.

name.description: Name shown on its tile. Default: the id.

seat.description: Whether a player can sit here, such as a player area.

color.description: Colour of its tile frame and chip: a name from the assets file's colours, such as `red`, or a CSS colour such as `#c5523a`.

SetupSurface.description: A surface the table starts with besides the Centre, in tile order.

SetupStep.description: One setup instruction. The first key (`place`, `deal` or `shuffle`) decides the kind.

place.description: A component id from a library (places every one of them in the inventory), the id of one of them, the start of their ids up to a dot (`worker.red` places `worker.red.1`, `worker.red.2`, …), or `{ deck: <name> }`.

surface.description: Surface an `[x, y]` position in `at` or `to` is on, from the setup's `surfaces`. Default: the Centre.

shuffle.description: Shuffle a deck after placing it.

lock.description: Lock it in place, as a board usually is once it is where it belongs.

PlaceStep.description: Put components or a deck somewhere on the table.

Target.description: Where something goes: an `[x, y]` position (on the Centre, or on the step's `surface`), a drop area as `component/area` or `component/area/index` (e.g. `main-board/market/2`), or `surface:<id>` for free room on a surface.

to.description: A snap target fills its spots in order; a position stacks the cards.

surface.description: Surface an `[x, y]` position in `at` or `to` is on, from the setup's `surfaces`. Default: the Centre.

DealStep.description: Deal cards from the top of a deck.
